title: Cloud Security: payment allocation
content:
Cloud Security payment allocation is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The bank record confirms the remittance as completed.

Record only a bank-confirmed remittance using an accepted remittance rail and the amount actually received in currency.

Customer consent to dispose of funds belongs to the customer; the agent only allocates a payment already confirmed by the bank.

Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use unspecified-remittance allocation order, sorting invoice issue time then original source event reference within the same customer and billing entity.

Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities.

Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference.

A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting.

No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

The net receivable includes all posted financial events through the frozen handling time, grouped by holding.

Sum the signed amounts of charges, upward adjustments, payment returns and refunds together with the negative amounts of payments and credits. This yields the receivable; there is no separately adjustable balance.

Positive financial amounts increase customer debt; negative payments and credits reduce it.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable payment action, authoritative system records must establish: The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a promise or pending payment count as a receipt?**

No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

## Payment promise

Hypothetical case: the customer promises payment while the bank still shows the remittance as pending. No payment posting is made.
